prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1374; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred when your insured turned left across our client's path. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now seeking compensation for medical treatment, lost income, and the pain and suffering that has followed.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office. Do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any contact with our client should be routed through our firm.

We also request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with any other policies that may apply to this loss, so that we can evaluate our client's claim properly.

Finally, we ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the accident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, witness statements, claim file notes, vehicle repair records, and any recorded statements. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
